novel_features.name: SLA breach radar
novel_features.description: List tickets at risk of breaching SLA in the next N hours, optionally filtered by unassigned.
novel_features.rationale: Combines tickets.dueDate, status, and assigneeId locally — no native Zoho view does both filters together.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this for cron-driven Slack alerts when tickets need an owner before they breach.

novel_features.name: Aging triage
novel_features.description: Open tickets where the last agent reply was more than N days ago.
novel_features.rationale: Joins tickets + threads locally to compute last-agent-reply age; no competing helpdesk CLI ships this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this in your morning triage to find tickets the customer is waiting on.

novel_features.name: Conversational full-text search
novel_features.description: FTS5 search across ticket subject, description, threads, and comments.
novel_features.rationale: SQLite FTS5 over locally-synced thread + comment content — Zoho's search endpoint is keyword-only on subject/description and rate-limited.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to recall a customer's exact error string from six weeks ago without paginating the API.

novel_features.name: Workload fairness
novel_features.description: Per-agent open-ticket counts with mean/stddev/Gini across the team.
novel_features.rationale: Groups locally by assigneeId per department; Zoho's stats endpoint returns per-agent totals but no cross-agent dispersion.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this for sprint planning — surfaces who's overloaded vs underloaded.

novel_features.name: Reopen-pattern detector
novel_features.description: Tickets that have been closed and reopened at least N times within a window.
novel_features.rationale: Scans local ticket_history (status transitions closed→open) — signals unresolved root causes.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this in weekly CSAT review to identify customers being repeatedly underserved.

novel_features.name: Reassignment helper
novel_features.description: Suggests the least-loaded active agent in a ticket's department for reassignment.
novel_features.rationale: Local rank by ascending open-ticket count; mechanical, read-only.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when manually reassigning — gives a defensible 'why this person' answer.

novel_features.name: Customer 360 view
novel_features.description: All tickets, accounts, and ticket stats for a contact in one query.
novel_features.rationale: Joins locally synced contacts × tickets × accounts; Zoho UI requires 3-click drill-down.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before reaching out to a customer — see their full history in one shot.

novel_features.name: Escalation audit
novel_features.description: Tickets reassigned to N or more distinct agents — surfaces ownership churn.
novel_features.rationale: Scans local ticket_history (assigneeChange events) grouped by ticketId; not exposed as a native Zoho report.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this in governance review to find tickets bouncing across teams.

narrative.headline: Every Zoho Desk API endpoint, plus offline FTS over conversation content and cross-agent insights no native view supports.
narrative.value_prop: Full coverage of Zoho Desk's tickets, contacts, accounts, agents, departments, and search modules — plus FTS5 over locally-synced ticket conversations, SLA-at-risk radar, workload fairness, reopen-pattern detection, and escalation audits. Built on a synced local SQLite store so support managers and agents can answer 'who has gaps?' and 'what's about to breach?' without rebuilding the Zoho UI in spreadsheets.
narrative.auth_narrative: Zoho Desk uses OAuth 2.0 only. You need a self-client refresh token, client ID/secret, and your org ID. Set ZOHODESK_REFRESH_TOKEN, ZOHODESK_CLIENT_ID, ZOHODESK_CLIENT_SECRET, ZOHODESK_ORG_ID — or run `zoho-desk-pp-cli auth set-token` to store them locally. The CLI auto-refreshes access tokens.

quickstart.comment: Validates OAuth creds + orgId + API reachability.
Populates SQLite with tickets, threads, comments, contacts, accounts, agents, departments.
Lists tickets approaching SLA breach in the next 4 hours.
Conversational FTS over local thread + comment content.

troubleshoots.fix: Refresh-token expired or scopes wrong. Re-run `zoho-desk-pp-cli auth set-token` with a fresh self-client refresh token from accounts.zoho.com/developerconsole.
Wrong data center URL. The CLI auto-detects from your org's region but if you mix DCs the orgId must match. Run `zoho-desk-pp-cli doctor` to see which base URL it resolved.
Zoho Desk limits to ~10 req/s per org. The CLI retries with backoff; for large initial syncs use `sync --since 30d --concurrency 1`.
FTS index is populated by `sync`. Run `sync --resources tickets,threads,comments` first.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for zoho-desk-pp-cli when you need to answer cross-entity questions about your support pipeline — SLA risk, workload distribution, reopen patterns, conversational search — without keeping Zoho's MCP server running. Also for cron-driven dashboards, BQ exports, and morning-triage automation. For one-off ticket CRUD an agent could call the API directly; use this CLI when the local store, FTS, or cross-agent joins matter.
